communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: ALPR Data Sharing Report
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The current LBPD Automated Licencse Plate Reader data sharing report containing the names of all agencies, fusion centers, and organizations with which the Agency currently shares ALPR scan data. 

If possible, I am also requesting the same data for the year 2025.  

Your department has provided this list numerous times in the past, so hopefully it will not be an issue providing it in a timely manner. 

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.



Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,
Greg Buhl
